examples.text_en: The interplay of light and dark made the picture great.
examples.text_zh: 光与暗的相互作用让这幅画很出色。

examples.text_en: There is a clear interplay between the mind and the body.
examples.text_zh: 心灵与身体之间有着明显的相互影响。

examples.text_en: He tried to interpolate a few words into the story.
examples.text_zh: 他试图在故事里插入几句话。

examples.text_en: They will interpolate new lines into the old song.
examples.text_zh: 他们将在这首老歌里插入新的段落。

examples.text_en: She had to interpose between the two big groups.
examples.text_zh: 她不得不在两个大群体之间介入。

examples.text_en: He would interpose a question when the talk stopped.
examples.text_zh: 谈话停下时，他会插进来问一个问题。

examples.text_en: The interregnum between the two men lasted a year.
examples.text_zh: 两位领导人之间的空位期持续了一年。

examples.text_en: During the interregnum, no one held real power.
examples.text_zh: 在过渡期间，没有人掌握实权。

examples.text_en: The police will interrogate him about the whole case.
examples.text_zh: 警方将就整个案件审问他。

examples.text_en: They began to interrogate the man for many hours.
examples.text_zh: 他们开始审问那个男人好几个小时。

examples.text_en: Every interrogative in the list was hard to answer.
examples.text_zh: 列表里的每个疑问词都很难回答。

examples.text_en: He used an interrogative to ask about the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他用一个疑问词来询问新计划。

examples.text_en: The loud talk was a bad interruption to our work.
examples.text_zh: 大声讲话严重打断了我们的工作。

examples.text_en: He hated any interruption when he was reading a book.
examples.text_zh: 他在读书时讨厌任何打扰。

examples.text_en: The two roads intersect near the old school.
examples.text_zh: 这两条路在旧学校附近相交。

examples.text_en: Their lives intersect at one point and then part.
examples.text_zh: 他们的人生在某一点相交，然后又分开。

examples.text_en: The intersected lines formed a beautiful small picture.
examples.text_zh: 交错的线条构成了一幅美丽的小图画。

examples.text_en: Their ways were intersected by many other roads.
examples.text_zh: 他们的道路被许多别的路交错贯穿。

examples.text_en: She likes to intersperse white among the blue and red.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢在蓝色和红色之间点缀白色。

examples.text_en: They will intersperse a few songs among the long talks.
examples.text_zh: 他们将在冗长的讲话中穿插几首歌。

examples.text_en: The interstellar trip would take many long years.
examples.text_zh: 这次星际旅行将耗费许多年。

examples.text_en: They studied the interstellar space between the stars.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了恒星之间的星际空间。

examples.text_en: Light came through a small interstice in the old wall.
examples.text_zh: 光线从旧墙的一个小缝隙里透进来。

examples.text_en: He could see her through the interstice between the boxes.
examples.text_zh: 他能透过箱子之间的空隙看见她。

examples.text_en: The two lines intertwine and form a single whole.
examples.text_zh: 这两条线相互缠绕，合成一个整体。

examples.text_en: Their hands intertwine as they walk through the park.
examples.text_zh: 他们走过公园时十指相扣。

examples.text_en: Her intervention stopped the fight between the two groups.
examples.text_zh: 她的介入阻止了两个群体之间的争斗。

examples.text_en: The intervention of the government helped the poor country.
examples.text_zh: 政府的干预帮了这个贫穷国家很多。

examples.text_en: The young man had three interviews for the same job.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人为了同一份工作参加了三次面谈。

examples.text_en: Her interviews with the people were long and serious.
examples.text_zh: 她对这些人的采访既漫长又严肃。

examples.text_en: The man will interweave the two stories into one.
examples.text_zh: 这个人会把两个故事交织成一个。

examples.text_en: Their words interweave fact and feeling in a natural way.
examples.text_zh: 他们的话语把事实和情感自然地交织在一起。

examples.text_en: He died intestate and left no clear rules.
examples.text_zh: 他死时没有留下遗嘱，也没有留下明确的规定。

examples.text_en: The man was intestate, so the court took control.
examples.text_zh: 这个人没有立遗嘱，所以由法院来接管。

examples.text_en: The intestine fight left the small country poor.
examples.text_zh: 这场内部争斗让这个小国变得贫穷。

examples.text_en: Such an intestine war can change a whole country.
examples.text_zh: 这样一场内战能改变整个国家。

examples.text_en: Their long love grew into real intimacy over time.
examples.text_zh: 他们长久的爱逐渐发展成了真正的亲密。

examples.text_en: He missed the intimacy they once shared at home.
examples.text_zh: 他怀念他们曾经在家里拥有的亲密。

examples.text_en: They had an intimate talk about love and life.
examples.text_zh: 他们就爱情和人生进行了一次亲密的交谈。

examples.text_en: This is an intimate matter between him and his wife.
examples.text_zh: 这是他和妻子之间的私事。

examples.text_en: They used intimidation to keep the whole group in line.
examples.text_zh: 他们用恐吓来让整个团体服从。

examples.text_en: His intimidation did not stop her from telling the truth.
examples.text_zh: 他的恐吓并没能阻止她说出真相。

examples.text_en: Her intonation made the old story feel real.
examples.text_zh: 她的语调让这个老故事显得很真实。

examples.text_en: He studied the intonation of the language for years.
examples.text_zh: 他研究这门语言的语调研究了许多年。

examples.text_en: The intoxication made it hard for him to walk home.
examples.text_zh: 醉意让他很难走回家。

examples.text_en: He felt a great intoxication after the great success.
examples.text_zh: 在巨大的成功之后，他感到一种强烈的陶醉。

examples.text_en: The intractable child would not do what he was told.
examples.text_zh: 这个倔强的孩子不肯照吩咐去做。

examples.text_en: This intractable problem has been with the team for years.
examples.text_zh: 这个棘手的问题已经困扰团队多年。

examples.text_en: The intransigent man would not change his mind at all.
examples.text_zh: 这个不肯妥协的男人一点也不愿改变主意。

examples.text_en: Both sides remained intransigent and the talk soon stopped.
examples.text_zh: 双方都不肯让步，谈话很快就中断了。

examples.text_en: The intrepid young man faced the fire without fear.
examples.text_zh: 这位无畏的年轻人毫不畏惧地面对大火。

examples.text_en: Her intrepid heart led the group through the dark night.
examples.text_zh: 她那勇猛的心带领团队穿过了黑夜。

examples.text_en: The intricacy of the old plan was too much for the team.
examples.text_zh: 这个旧计划的复杂程度让整个团队都吃不消。

examples.text_en: He loved the intricacy of the small gold cup.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢这个小金杯的精巧繁复。

examples.text_en: The two lines were intricately one single whole.
examples.text_zh: 这两条线错综复杂地合成了一体。

examples.text_en: She built the small house intricately and with care.
examples.text_zh: 她细致又精巧地搭建了那座小房子。

examples.text_en: The intriguing story kept the whole group up all night.
examples.text_zh: 这个吸引人的故事让整个团队一夜没睡。

examples.text_en: She found his simple question quite intriguing.
examples.text_zh: 她觉得他那简单的问题相当有趣。

examples.text_en: The intrinsic value of the gold was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 这块黄金的固有价值对所有人来说都显而易见。

examples.text_en: Care is not an intrinsic part of human life.
examples.text_zh: 关怀并不是人类生活与生俱来的一部分。

examples.text_en: The introspective man spent long hours in deep thought.
examples.text_zh: 这个内省的男人花了很长时间陷入深思。

examples.text_en: Her introspective way of writing made the book special.
examples.text_zh: 她内省的写作方式让这本书很特别。

examples.text_en: The intruder came into the house through a back door.
examples.text_zh: 那个闯入者从后门进入了房子。

examples.text_en: They found the intruder in the dark room at night.
examples.text_zh: 他们在夜里发现闯入者待在黑暗的房间里。

examples.text_en: He was always intruding into the private life of others.
examples.text_zh: 他总是打扰别人的私生活。

examples.text_en: Her intruding questions made the whole group feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 她那些强行插入的问题让整个团队都很不舒服。

examples.text_en: The loud talk was an intrusion into our happy home.
examples.text_zh: 大声讲话是对我们幸福家庭的一种侵扰。

examples.text_en: He did not like this intrusion into his private life.
examples.text_zh: 他不喜欢有人这样闯入他的私生活。

examples.text_en: His intrusive questions made everyone in the room feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他那些打扰人的问题让房间里每个人都不舒服。

examples.text_en: She found the new light too intrusive for her work.
examples.text_zh: 她觉得这盏新灯对她的工作来说太刺眼了。

examples.text_en: Her intuitive answer turned out to be the right one.
examples.text_zh: 她凭直觉给出的答案结果是对的。

examples.text_en: He had an intuitive feel for the needs of others.
examples.text_zh: 他对别人的需求有一种直觉上的体会。

examples.text_en: The intumescence in his arm was clear and hot.
examples.text_zh: 他手臂上的肿块又明显又发烫。

examples.text_en: They watched the intumescence form over a few days.
examples.text_zh: 他们看着这个肿块在几天里形成。

examples.text_en: The big water can inundate the whole town in time.
examples.text_zh: 大水迟早会淹没整个小镇。

examples.text_en: People began to inundate his office after the news.
examples.text_zh: 消息传出后，人们开始涌向他的办公室。

examples.text_en: Hard work will inure the body to long hours.
examples.text_zh: 艰苦的工作会让身体习惯于长时间的劳作。

examples.text_en: They tried to inure themselves to the pain and loss.
examples.text_zh: 他们努力让自己习惯痛苦与失去。

examples.text_en: He was inured to hard work from a young age.
examples.text_zh: 他从小就习惯了艰苦的工作。

examples.text_en: Years at work left her inured to great loss.
examples.text_zh: 多年的工作让她对巨大的损失习以为常。

examples.text_en: The new facts may invalidate the whole old case.
examples.text_zh: 这些新事实可能会使整个旧案子失效。

examples.text_en: A single mistake can invalidate the result of the test.
examples.text_zh: 一个错误就可能使这次测试的结果无效。

examples.text_en: In this system, the invariable never changes at all.
examples.text_zh: 在这个体系中，不变的东西永远不会改变。

examples.text_en: He saw the truth as an invariable in his work.
examples.text_zh: 他把事实看作自己工作中的一个常量。

examples.text_en: She was invariably the first to come to work.
examples.text_zh: 她总是第一个来上班。

examples.text_en: He invariably said yes to any new idea.
examples.text_zh: 他对任何新想法总是一口答应。

examples.text_en: His words were full of invective against the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他的话里满是对整个团队的恶言谩骂。

examples.text_en: She could not take the invective from the old man.
examples.text_zh: 她受不了那个老人恶语相向。

examples.text_en: He began to inveigh against the new law at once.
examples.text_zh: 他立刻开始痛骂这项新法律。

examples.text_en: They would inveigh against the plan for many hours.
examples.text_zh: 他们会一连好几个小时痛斥那个计划。

examples.text_en: He tried to inveigle her into giving him the money.
examples.text_zh: 他试图诱骗她把钱交给他。

examples.text_en: They would inveigle young people into the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们会诱使年轻人参与这个新计划。

examples.text_en: The inventor built a small thing in his own room.
examples.text_zh: 这位发明家在自己的房间里做出了一个小东西。

examples.text_en: He became a great inventor in a few short years.
examples.text_zh: 他在短短几年内成了一位了不起的发明家。

examples.text_en: They keep a full inventory of every thing.
examples.text_zh: 他们为每一件东西都保留了完整的清单。

examples.text_en: He checked the inventory before the doors opened.
examples.text_zh: 他开门之前核对了一遍存货清单。

examples.text_en: The invertebrate thing had no hard part at all.
examples.text_zh: 这种无脊椎的东西身上没有任何坚硬的部分。

examples.text_en: He called the man invertebrate for giving up so soon.
examples.text_zh: 他骂这个人没骨气，这么快就放弃了。

examples.text_en: The investigators asked many questions about the whole case.
examples.text_zh: 调查人员就整个案子问了许多问题。

examples.text_en: Two investigators came to the office early that morning.
examples.text_zh: 那天清早，两名调查员来到了办公室。

examples.text_en: The investiture took place in the old town school.
examples.text_zh: 授职仪式在镇上的老学校里举行。

examples.text_en: Many people came to watch the investiture that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天许多人前来观看授职典礼。

examples.text_en: He had an inveterate love of games and music.
examples.text_zh: 他对游戏和音乐有着根深蒂固的爱好。

examples.text_en: Their inveterate way of life was hard to change.
examples.text_zh: 他们积习已久的生活方式很难改变。

examples.text_en: Such an invidious question made everyone feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 这样一个惹人不快的问题让每个人都不舒服。

examples.text_en: They saw the new rule as invidious and wrong.
examples.text_zh: 他们认为这条新规则既招人反感又不对。

examples.text_en: A good sleep will invigorate the body and the mind.
examples.text_zh: 好好睡一觉会让身心都充满活力。

examples.text_en: The new plan helped invigorate the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 这个新计划帮助振作了整个团队的士气。

examples.text_en: The water was invigorating on a hot day.
examples.text_zh: 在炎热的天气里，这水让人精神一振。

examples.text_en: They had an invigorating walk through the green park.
examples.text_zh: 他们在绿意盎然的公园里精神抖擞地散步。

examples.text_en: The old team seemed invincible for a whole year.
examples.text_zh: 这支队整整一年似乎都不可战胜。

examples.text_en: He believed his love for her was invincible.
examples.text_zh: 他相信自己对她的爱坚不可摧。

examples.text_en: The old man said a short invocation before the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 老人在长途旅行前念了一段简短的祷词。

examples.text_en: They used an invocation to ask for help from above.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一段祈祷来祈求上天的帮助。

examples.text_en: They sent an invoice for the things last week.
examples.text_zh: 他们上周寄来了这些东西的发票。

examples.text_en: He checked the invoice before he paid the money.
examples.text_zh: 他付钱之前核对了一下发票。

examples.text_en: She would invoke the old law to help her family.
examples.text_zh: 她会援引那条旧法律来帮助自己的家人。

examples.text_en: They invoke the name of the king in every song.
examples.text_zh: 他们在每首歌里都呼唤国王的名字。

examples.text_en: His involvement in the whole case was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 他对整个案子的卷入对所有人来说都很清楚。

examples.text_en: She wanted no involvement in their private fight.
examples.text_zh: 她不想卷进他们之间的私人争斗。

examples.text_en: The old wall seemed invulnerable to any attack.
examples.text_zh: 这堵旧墙似乎任何攻击都伤害不了。

examples.text_en: He felt invulnerable when he was with his friends.
examples.text_zh: 和朋友们在一起时，他觉得自己无懈可击。

examples.text_en: His inward joy showed on his face at the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 在会上，他内心的喜悦流露在脸上。

examples.text_en: She turned her mind inward and thought for a while.
examples.text_zh: 她把心思转向内心，思考了一会儿。

examples.text_en: She put iodine on the small cut on his hand.
examples.text_zh: 她在他手上那个小伤口上涂了碘酒。

examples.text_en: Iodine is often used to help a cut on the body.
examples.text_zh: 碘酒常被用来处理身上的伤口。

examples.text_en: The ion carries a small part through the water.
examples.text_zh: 离子带着一个极小的部分穿过水。

examples.text_en: They studied how an ion moves in the air and water.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了离子如何在空气和水中移动。

examples.text_en: The ionosphere is far above the earth and the sea.
examples.text_zh: 电离层远在地球和海洋之上。

examples.text_en: They sent a light up into the ionosphere.
examples.text_zh: 他们向电离层发射了一束光。

examples.text_en: He did not care one iota about their words.
examples.text_zh: 他一点也不在乎他们说的话。

examples.text_en: There is not an iota of truth in his story.
examples.text_zh: 他的故事里没有一丝一毫的真实。

examples.text_en: The irascible old man would fight with everyone.
examples.text_zh: 这个暴躁的老人对谁都要发脾气。

examples.text_en: His irascible way made him hard to live with.
examples.text_zh: 他易怒的性子让人很难和他相处。

examples.text_en: The irate man wrote a long report to the court.
examples.text_zh: 这个愤怒的男人给法院写了一份长长的报告。

examples.text_en: She was irate when she heard the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 她听到这个坏消息时非常生气。

examples.text_en: His ire was clear when he saw the broken cup.
examples.text_zh: 看到杯子打碎时，他的怒火显而易见。

examples.text_en: She could not stop her ire at the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 听到这个坏消息，她无法压制自己的愤怒。

examples.text_en: The iridescence of the light made the room beautiful.
examples.text_zh: 光的彩虹色让房间变得美丽。

examples.text_en: They watched the iridescence on the water at night.
examples.text_zh: 他们夜晚看着水面上的彩虹色光泽。

examples.text_en: The iridescent light gave the whole room joy.
examples.text_zh: 彩虹色的光给整个房间带来了喜悦。

examples.text_en: The cup was iridescent and stood out on the table.
examples.text_zh: 这个杯子是彩虹色的，在桌上格外显眼。

examples.text_en: Such small things can irk him for the whole day.
examples.text_zh: 这样的小事能让他烦恼一整天。

examples.text_en: It would irk her to wait without any good reason.
examples.text_zh: 没有任何正当理由地等着，会让她很厌烦。

examples.text_en: The irksome work took him many long hours.
examples.text_zh: 这件令人厌烦的工作花了他许多个小时。

examples.text_en: His irksome questions made the whole group feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他那些招人烦的问题让整个团队都不舒服。

examples.text_en: The ironclad rule could not be changed by anyone.
examples.text_zh: 这条铁定的规则谁也无法更改。

examples.text_en: They had an ironclad deal about the small land.
examples.text_zh: 他们围绕那块小土地订有一个铁定的协议。

examples.text_en: Ironically, the plan stopped for the very same reason.
examples.text_zh: 讽刺的是，这个计划恰恰因为同样的原因停了下来。

examples.text_en: She talked ironically about her own great success.
examples.text_zh: 她讽刺地谈起自己那巨大的成功。

examples.text_en: The irony of the whole thing was not lost on us.
examples.text_zh: 这件事的讽刺意味我们并没有忽视。

examples.text_en: He could not see the irony in his own words.
examples.text_zh: 他看不出自己话里的讽刺。

examples.text_en: The sun will irradiate the whole land with its light.
examples.text_zh: 太阳将用它的光芒照耀整片大地。

examples.text_en: Her words seemed to irradiate the room with new hope.
examples.text_zh: 她的话似乎用新的希望照亮了整个房间。

examples.text_en: The old fear was irradicable and stayed for years.
examples.text_zh: 这种旧有的恐惧无法根除，持续了许多年。

examples.text_en: They found the problem irradicable and gave up.
examples.text_zh: 他们发现这个问题无法根除，便放弃了。

examples.text_en: Their two ideas were irreconcilable and caused a fight.
examples.text_zh: 他们两人的想法无法调和，引发了一场争吵。

examples.text_en: The two groups remained irreconcilable after the long talk.
examples.text_zh: 长谈之后，两个群体依然无法和解。

examples.text_en: The loss was irredeemable and could not be changed.
examples.text_zh: 这次损失无法挽回，也改变不了。

examples.text_en: He saw his mistake as an irredeemable act.
examples.text_zh: 他把自己的错误看作一个无可补救的行为。

examples.text_en: The cost was irreducible and could not go any lower.
examples.text_zh: 这项费用无法削减，不能再低了。

examples.text_en: They faced an irreducible difference in their two plans.
examples.text_zh: 他们的两个方案之间存在着不可调和的分歧。

examples.text_en: The irregularity in the data made the result hard.
examples.text_zh: 数据中的不规则让结果变得难以判断。

examples.text_en: They found an irregularity in the old records.
examples.text_zh: 他们在旧记录中发现了一处异常。

examples.text_en: The lights went on and off irregularly all night.
examples.text_zh: 灯光整晚忽明忽暗，很不规律。

examples.text_en: He worked irregularly and often missed the morning meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他工作不规律，经常错过早会。

examples.text_en: His answer was irrelevant to the question we asked.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答与我们所问的问题毫不相干。

examples.text_en: The old facts were irrelevant to the new case.
examples.text_zh: 这些旧事实与新的案子没有关系。

examples.text_en: The loss was irremediable and left him in deep pain.
examples.text_zh: 这次损失无法挽回，让他陷入深深的痛苦。

examples.text_en: They saw the mistake as an irremediable problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这个错误看作无法补救的问题。

examples.text_en: The loss to the old house was irreparable.
examples.text_zh: 这栋老房子所遭受的损失无法弥补。

examples.text_en: They felt the break between them was irreparable.
examples.text_zh: 他们觉得两人之间的裂痕已无法修复。

examples.text_en: Her irrepressible joy was clear to the whole house.
examples.text_zh: 那天她抑制不住的喜悦弥漫了整栋房子。

examples.text_en: He had an irrepressible need to tell the truth.
examples.text_zh: 他有一种抑制不住的冲动，想要说出真相。

examples.text_en: Her work was irreproachable and won the trust of all.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作无可挑剔，赢得了所有人的信任。

examples.text_en: He led an irreproachable life and helped many people.
examples.text_zh: 他过着无可指摘的生活，帮助了很多人。

examples.text_en: The irresolute man could not make up his mind.
examples.text_zh: 这个优柔寡断的人拿不定主意。

examples.text_en: She was irresolute about the big decision for weeks.
examples.text_zh: 她在那个重大决定上犹豫了好几个星期。

examples.text_en: His irreverence toward the old man made us feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他对老人的不敬让我们很难受。

examples.text_en: They saw the act as irreverence and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这一举动看作不敬，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: His irreverent words about the king caused a fight.
examples.text_zh: 他那些对国王不敬的话引发了一场争斗。

examples.text_en: The irreverent boy did not follow the old rules.
examples.text_zh: 这个不逊的男孩不遵守旧规矩。

examples.text_en: The change in the whole system was irreversible.
examples.text_zh: 整个系统的变化是不可逆转的。

examples.text_en: They knew the loss was irreversible and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他们知道这次损失无法挽回，便什么也没说。

examples.text_en: The court said the decision was final and irrevocable.
examples.text_zh: 法院说这个决定是最终的，不可撤销。

examples.text_en: It was an irrevocable step that changed her life.
examples.text_zh: 这是改变了她一生的、不可逆转的一步。

examples.text_en: They use water to irrigate the land each year.
examples.text_zh: 他们每年都用水灌溉这片土地。

examples.text_en: The long line can irrigate the whole field in one day.
examples.text_zh: 这条长长的水渠能在一天内灌溉整片田地。

examples.text_en: The irrigation of the land helped the poor people.
examples.text_zh: 对土地的灌溉帮助了这些穷人。

examples.text_en: They built a simple system of irrigation for the field.
examples.text_zh: 他们为这片田地建了一套简易的灌溉系统。

examples.text_en: His irritating words made the whole group feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他那些气人的话让整个团队都不舒服。

examples.text_en: The irritating light kept her up most of the night.
examples.text_zh: 刺眼的灯光让她一整夜几乎没睡。

examples.text_en: They had to isolate the old man from the group.
examples.text_zh: 他们不得不把这个老人与群体隔离开来。

examples.text_en: The new law may isolate the small town even more.
examples.text_zh: 这项新法律可能让这个小镇更加孤立。

examples.text_en: His years of isolation made him hard and inward.
examples.text_zh: 多年的隔绝让他变得冷硬而内向。

examples.text_en: The small town lived in full isolation for years.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇多年来与世隔绝。

examples.text_en: The isotope of the same thing can be quite different.
examples.text_zh: 同一种东西的同位素可能相当不同。

examples.text_en: They studied one isotope of the rock for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们对这种岩石的一种同位素研究了许多年。

examples.text_en: The small isthmus holds the two parts of land together.
examples.text_zh: 这个小小的地峡把两块陆地连在一起。

examples.text_en: They walked across the isthmus to the other side.
examples.text_zh: 他们走过地峡来到另一边。
